newsitem.title: RUSSIA: LUKoil Q1 output up 4.6 pct, product exports soar.
newsitem.headline: LUKoil Q1 output up 4.6 pct, product exports soar.

text.p: LUKoil, Russia's biggest oil company, said on Monday it produced 15 million tonnes (1.2 million barrels per day) of oil in the first quarter, up 4.6 percent from the same year-ago period.
A company statement said the total included joint-venture production.
Oil exports were stable at 3.8 million tonnes (304,000 bpd) in the first three months of the year, while oil product exports jumped 52.7 percent year-on-year to 1.4 million tonnes.
Gas production in the first quarter hit 825 million cubic metres.
Oil refining at LUKoil's own plants was 4.8 million tonnes (384,000 bpd). LUKoil refined an additional one million tonnes (80,000 bpd) through tolling deals at non-company refineries.
Net sales rose 8.4 percent year-on-year over January-March to 12.57 trillion roubles ($2.26 billion).
It said that slower growth in production costs helped lift profits from basic operations by 16.7 percent year-on-year to 1.19 trillion roubles.
First-quarter net profits rose 11.5 percent to 757 billion roubles ($132 million) during the first three months of 1997 from 679 billion ($118 million) in the first quarter of 1996.
The company said the financial results were based on Russian accounting standards and on a cash basis.
